about: Widgets (antennas ...) the Xbox converter removes from an object tag, keyed by CONTENT: the object tag name, the widget tag name and the content digest of the object's Model (hlmt) tag as the converter computes it (stock_index.Digester). The same object name over a different model keeps its widget. Only names and digests, no game data.

rules.note: the Phantom pack's bulldog: a warthog tag over the bulldog motorcycle model, which has no antenna marker (Xbox draws no antenna, Vista would draw it at the model origin)
